decisions.reason: Its dedicated website pages over two years signal visible commitment and accumulated investment, making persistence likely under escalation.

Although the orthopedic shoe last is distant from the core, its own webpage shows public commitment and only one year on the market lets weak results be seen as temporary, so escalation favors keeping it.

The post-curing unit is close to the established offer but has only a website mention, so limited public commitment raises the probability of dropping somewhat, though recent results still allow keeping.
